name: NOET miner (cloud-start)
readme: Mines NOET Mainnet on one or more NVIDIA GPUs. Set NOET_ADDRESS to your noet1 address. 48 GB cards (A40, RTX A6000, L40S) or larger keep mining after the switch to Qwen3-14B at block 3,500; on 24 GB cards set NOET_14B=0. The first start builds the engine and models (6 to 12 minutes on a fast host); progress is in /root/noet.log. Source and documentation: https://github.com/noetnetwork/noetnetwork/tree/main/protocol/miner
dockerStartCmd: apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends curl ca-certificates >/dev/null; curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/noetnetwork/noetnetwork/main/protocol/miner/cloud-start.sh | bash; sleep infinity
